column6: eval (() => {   const links = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a')).map(a => ({ text: a.textContent, href: a.getAttribute('href') }));   return links.filter(l => l.href && l.href.includes('Giant-impact')); })()
eval (() => {   const paras = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#mw-content-text p')).slice(0, 5).map(p => p.textContent);   return paras.join('\n\n'); })()

eval (() => {   const elements = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#mw-content-text p, #mw-content-text table')).map(el => el.textContent);   return elements.filter(t => t.toLowerCase().includes('billion years ago') || t.toLowerCase().includes('bya') || t.toLowerCase().includes('gigaannum')).slice(0, 10); })()
